campaigns.description: Machines And Cloud LLC (Machines & Cloud) replies to people who text +13464853328 with questions about its own AI front desk software, onboarding or account access. Replies provide product information, setup guidance or links to secure account support. This campaign does not send on behalf of home-service shops or their homeowners. No recurring, proactive, promotional or missed-call texts are sent.
campaigns.message_flow: A person starts by texting HELP or their own question to +13464853328. The public invitation and disclosures are at https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html#platform-sms. Only direct replies about that person's Machines & Cloud product, onboarding or account-support question are permitted. The inbound message is retained as consent evidence for that exchange; it does not authorize recurring engagement. Calling, emailing, signup, booking or providing a phone number is not SMS consent. No website checkbox, purchased list or verbal opt-in is used. Message frequency varies with the messages the person sends. Message and data rates may apply. HELP or AYUDA provides help; STOP, ALTO or PARAR ends texts. START, UNSTOP or EMPEZAR only removes an earlier block and does not subscribe the person to recurring texts. Terms: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html. Privacy: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/privacy-policy.html#sms. Public CTA: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html#platform-sms. It invites HELP or a question to +13464853328 for direct M&C support, not recurring enrollment. User: HELP. Reply: Machines & Cloud product help: https://machinesandcloud.com/#pilot. Sign in: https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to stop texts. Calling or signup is not SMS consent.
message_samples: Machines & Cloud: explore our AI front desk at https://machinesandcloud.com/#demo-wrap. Product and setup help: https://machinesandcloud.com/#pilot. Reply STOP to stop texts.

Machines & Cloud: sign in securely at https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Request a fresh email link there. Never text a password or sign-in code. Reply STOP to stop texts.
campaigns.help_message: Machines & Cloud product help: https://machinesandcloud.com/#pilot. Sign in: https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to stop texts.
campaigns.opt_in_message: Machines & Cloud: your texting block is removed. We only reply to messages you send; no recurring texts. Reply HELP for help or STOP to stop.
campaigns.opt_out_message: Machines & Cloud: texts stopped. Reply START or EMPEZAR to remove the block.
